app.name: PackInspect
search.hint: Type to search package managers and installed packages
ops.willRun: The following command will run (generated from the backend allow-list; the frontend cannot alter its arguments)
ops.destructiveWarning: This removes or replaces software on your system and may break other tools that depend on it. Make sure the target package is correct.
ops.acknowledge: I understand the consequences and want to run this on the package above
ops.safetyNote: The command runs via your local package manager and its full output is shown. The manager is rescanned afterwards to refresh the list.
ops.refreshHint: The list was rescanned automatically. If the result is unexpected, copy the command above and run it manually.
status.scanFailedHint: These managers could not be read; see the activity log
manager.notInstalledBody: No executable for this package manager was found, so its package list cannot be read. Install it first, or check the official docs.
manager.noRegistry: This ecosystem has no registry configuration
browse.title: Search the {name} registry
browse.placeholder: Package name, e.g. vue / requests / ripgrep
browse.initial: Type a keyword to search the online registry
browse.unsupported: Online browsing is not available for this ecosystem
browse.copyFailed: Copy failed, please select the text manually
browse.noExecute: PackInspect never runs install or uninstall for you — that would modify your real environment, and dependency resolution plus permission prompts cannot be handled reliably in the background.
about.title: About
about.projectNote: PackInspect scans your local package environment: it only reads information and never changes your environment for you.
toolbar.measureHint: Measure each package directory (slower, walks the filesystem)
manage.title: Package managers
manage.subtitle: Manage installed packages of detected managers; download the missing ones
manage.emptyHint: Install at least one package manager, then hit "Re-detect"
manage.futureNote: Scanning is not wired up yet for this manager; only detection is shown
packages.name: Package
packages.emptyHint: Hit "Scan" in the top right. Enabling "Measure sizes" walks every package directory and is much slower.
packages.noMatchHint: Clear the search box or switch the scope in the sidebar.
detail.title: Package details
detail.copyFailed: Copy failed, please select the text manually
detail.safetyNote: This tool only reads package metadata; it never uninstalls anything. Use the equivalent command shown above to remove a package.
cache.emptyHint: Run a scan to measure cache directories. Measuring only reads file sizes and changes nothing.
cache.note: Note: this is measurement only. Use "Clean cache" in the toolbar to delete — it previews first and asks for confirmation.
registry.pickManagerHint: Registry settings are read per manager.
registry.title: {name} registry
registry.previewLabel: Preview of the saved config file:
registry.saveNote: The original file is backed up as *.bak-<timestamp> first. Only the line you edited is changed.
registry.noRegistry: This manager has no registry configuration
registry.rawMissing: (file does not exist yet; it will be created on save)
settings.title: Settings
settings.scanOnStartupHint: Scan installed packages right after launch (disable for faster startup)
settings.showIconsHint: Render an icon for every package in the list
settings.safetyBody: The frontend cannot run shell commands or touch the filesystem. Every command runs in Rust against a static allow-list. Cache cleaning is restricted to known cache directories and always requires a dry-run preview plus confirmation.
report.title: Scan summary
report.exportHint: JSON = full data; CSV = packages + cache; Markdown = readable tables. You pick the path; Rust writes the file.
clean.title: Clean cache
clean.warning: Only caches and temp files are deleted. No package is uninstalled, and node_modules / site-packages / virtualenvs are never touched.
clean.typedConfirm: This is a large cleanup (≥ 1 GB). Type DELETE to confirm:
error.title: Something went wrong
browse.reinstallHint: Already installed locally; click to build a reinstall command
browse.emptyHint: Try another keyword; for ecosystems without keyword search, enter the full package name.
packages.loadingHint: Results appear as soon as each manager finishes; you do not need to wait for all of them.
packages.matchContext: keyword "{keyword}" · manager {manager} · {total} packages in this manager
browse.executeHint: You can install directly or copy the command. A confirmation shows the exact command before anything runs.
